title: Expose additional theming options
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [X] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Expose additional theming options in `config.toml` to allow better customization of apps. 

### Why?

The current set of [theming options](https://<redacted-host>/develop/concepts/configuration/theming) is quite minimal and doesn't allow to create a cohesive theme. A couple of additional options would allow better app customization, especially for aligning Streamlit apps better with company themes. 

### How?

Provide additional theming options that can be defined in `config.toml` like:

- Allow custom fonts (via URL?)
    - Related feature requests: #7274 & #5803

- Allow changing predefined colors used for:
  - Alert elements like `st.info`, `st.warning`, `st.success`, …
  - Chart theme colors used in `altair_chart`, `plotly_chart`, and our internal charts. This is mainly referring to a categorical, diverging, and sequential color palette.
  - Markdown: link color & inline-code color
  - Metrics delta color
  - Markdown: text and background color like red, green , …
 - Default text size
   - maybe only with a couple of predefined options (small / medium / large)
 - Default spacing (to influence padding & gaps used around and within elements)
    - maybe only a couple of predefined options (compact / default)
 - Roundness (radius) of elements
   - maybe only a couple of predefined options (none / small / medium / large)
 - Default border width & color
 - Sidebar text color

For example: 

```js
font: "sans serif" | "serif" | "monospace" | str (custom font URL)

text_size: "small" | "medium" | "large"
radius_size: "none" | "small" | "medium" | "large"
spacing_size: "compact" | "default" | "large"

sidebar_text_color: str (hex color)

success_color: str (hex color) 
warning_color: str (hex color)
info_color: str (hex color)
error_color: str (hex color)

link_color: str (hex color)
inline_code_color: str (hex color)

chart_categorical_colors: list[str] (list of hex colors)
chart_diverging_colors: list[str] (list of hex colors)
chart_sequential_colors: list[str] (list of hex colors)

positive_delta_color: str (hex color)
negative_delta_color: str (hex color)
```

comments.author: participant3
comments.body:
I hate to be the party pooper for such a powerful feature, even though most people believe that custom fonts and colors are just for fun. When you have features like st.write and are compiling automated scripts from random people, those fonts can run difficult to detect code tricks from parsers and linters in various environments. 

With agentic AI already out in the wild, these features go against transparency and ultimately trust in using the more powerful and privacy preserving features of AI in the long run. If you’d like, I can share some ideas and code about how these features can be developed in a safer and easier way.

comments.author: participant7
comments.body:
# Update

Hey all! In the next release (1.44) that will go live tomorrow, we're adding the following new theming options:

- linkColor
- codeFont
- headingFont
- baseRadius
- borderColor
- showWidgetBorder
- baseFontSize
- showSidebarBorder
- codeBackgroundColor

Also, you'll be able to define custom fonts (for the existing `font` config option as well as for the new `codeFont` and `headingFont` options) and set the sidebar theming parameters independently from the rest of the app (via `[theme.sidebar]`). 

We'll continue to add a few more config options in the next releases, will update here once we're there!

comments.author: participant7
comments.body:
Going to close this! With the next release (1.47) the following theming options will be available in Streamlit:

- primaryColor
- backgroundColor
- secondaryBackgroundColor
- textColor
- font
- borderColor
- baseRadius
- baseFontSize
- baseFontWeight
- showSidebarBorder
- showWidgetBorder
- buttonRadius
- dataframeBorderColor
- dataframeHeaderBackgroundColor
- linkColor
- linkUnderline
- headingFont
- headingFontSizes
- headingFontWeights
- codeFont
- codeFontSize
- codeFontWeight
- codeBackgroundColor
- chartCategoricalColors
- chartSequentialColors


We will still add a few more options to customize colors in the next few months and might add a few additional theming improvements such as custom dark theme or a `theme.toml` file that you can reuse in apps. Will update in the relevant issues!
